description: Figure 10 illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, presented in that order. The vertical axis represents “effect,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5, and no units specified.  There are nine sets of three bars for each language family. Within each set, the first bar, colored red, is labeled “mBERT-R₁”; the second bar, colored green, is labeled “mBERT-R₂”; and the third bar, colored blue, is labeled “XLM-R₂”.  The bars are arranged side-by-side for each language family. For example, for the IE-Baltic language family, the mBERT-R₁ bar reaches approximately 22, the mBERT-R₂ bar reaches approximately 18, and the XLM-R₂ bar reaches approximately 15.  For the Uralic language family, the mBERT-R₁ bar reaches approximately 5, the mBERT-R₂ bar reaches approximately 3, and the XLM-R₂ bar reaches approximately 4. Error bars, indicating the standard deviation, are present on top of each bar. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation, and the bars are not sorted in any apparent order.
